title: hard retest: profiles.py by Larry
instructions: You MUST import devices.py (already accepted, in your workspace) and use its classify and clamp_volume rather than repeating the device names or the volume ceilings. Two rules matter more than the rest: a locked profile's volumes never change, no matter what is asked; and a profile is a plain dict that survives being written to a settings file and read back, so nothing clever - no classes, no tuples, no objects that JSON cannot hold. Every function that changes a profile returns a new dict and leaves the one it was given exactly as it was.
